summary: Tencent Cloud TokenHub gives root accounts a one-time free trial quota per eligible model. Each eligible language model gets 1,000,000 free tokens valid 1 year from claim; the campaign enrollment end is December 31, 2026, distinct from the quota's usage validity. Other model types may have different validity periods; confirm the claimed package. TokenHub is an OpenAI-compatible gateway serving Tencent Hy4 and Hy4 flash, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax and other models. As of 2026-11-16, TokenHub's promo page advertises a Hy4 flash Free Trial for new users (up to 1 million free tokens); that page says the tokens are valid for 90 days while the trial doc still says 1 year, so use them early. Paid Hy4 is 50% off through December 31, 2026, which is a discount, not part of the free trial. Claiming or enabling postpaid for a model freezes USD 10 of account balance, returned after resources are terminated. Postpaid is optional: without it, service stops when the free quota is exhausted or expires.
claim_steps: Log in to the TokenHub console and activate the platform.

On the Model Gallery page, click 'New User Free Trial', select models, then 'Claim Now'. Free trial can also be auto-claimed on first invocation of a supported model. Each root account can claim once per model.

Maintain enough balance or credit limit: USD 10 is frozen per model claim/postpaid enablement and returned after resources are terminated. Delete all model endpoints to reclaim it; deleting a default endpoint requires customer service.
Use language-model quota within 1 year of claim; unused quota expires. Confirm validity for other model types. Campaign enrollment ends December 31, 2026.
Postpaid is optional. Without it, service stops after the free quota is exhausted or expires; enabling it bills subsequent token usage at the model's rates.
